translations.web: So I was left alone, and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; for my face grew deathly pale, and I retained no strength.
translations.bsb: So I was left alone, gazing at this great vision. No strength remained in me; my face grew deathly pale, and I was powerless.
translations.kjv: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
translations.asv: So I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me; for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
